newsitem.title: CANADA: Hydro-Quebec names as CEO Gaz Metro CEO. [CORRECTED 21:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Hydro-Quebec names as CEO Gaz Metro CEO. [CORRECTED 21:50 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline from "names Gaz Metro CEO as chair")
The Quebec government said on Wednesday it named Gaz Metropolitain and Co LP chief executive Andre Caille chief executive and president of the provincially owned utility, (corrects from "chairman").

The announcement followed the September firing of Yvon Martineau as chairman. His departure had been rumored since last spring because of executive disputes and a power struggle with Quebec Energy Minister Guy Chevrette.
Hydro recently named Jean-Andre Elie as interim chairman.
